requirement: The extracted requirement must be the authored Markdown after its definition role through the end of its paragraph, trimming only outer whitespace.
justification: Scenarios: multi-line Markdown, formatting, reference roles, trailing whitespace, CRLF, and following rationale. The paragraph source range is sliced after the role and trim removes only outer whitespace. Exact string assertions preserve internal Markdown and line breaks while excluding the next paragraph. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
